title: MA2H Submit Ack (v0.5)
description: Body of the 202 Accepted returned by POST /v1/messages. v0.5 lists two additions for the addressed (inter-agent) path: `status: queued` and the `destination` reachability snapshot — this schema is closed (additionalProperties: false), so both are deliberate, listed changes (spec §8.1; SCP #24 Backward compatibility).

status.description: The §7/§14.2 lifecycle status (per spec §1, `status` on this ack is 'open, delivered, or a terminal value'). At first accept: `open` for a human-inbox ask/task; `delivered` for a human-inbox notify; `queued` for ANY addressed (`to`-carrying) message, notify included — an addressed message is parked in a mailbox and may still bounce or expire unseen, so the ack never asserts delivery (spec §8.1). An idempotent same-payload replay returns the original ack with the message's CURRENT status (spec §8.1), which may be any terminal — e.g. `bounced`/`expired` for an addressed notify, or a §7 resolution for an ask/task.

destination.description: REQUIRED on the ack for an addressed submit (v0.5, spec §8.1): the destination's reachability at send time. When the sender lacks visibility for the destination, exactly {"state": "unknown"} with no last_seen (schema-enforced below, mirroring presence.schema.json). Its absence on an addressed-submit ack means a pre-0.5 Hub misrouted the message to the human inbox — a 0.5 sender MUST treat that as a failure (spec §8.1).
